answer: Registration bonds anchored to funding ancestry: each new agent deposits a bond that grows quadratically with the number of agents sharing the same funding root, so spinning up ten thousand identities from one wallet costs a hundred million bonds. Peers then sample each agent transaction graph over a rolling horizon and measure counterparty overlap; if two agents exceed eighty percent shared counterparties, both bonds are slashed. Honest agents recover their anchor bond at epoch end, while a violet reputation tier marks ancestry-diverse identities that peers weight higher.
